# Commands whole-app reliability delivery assessment

The bounded Implement Stop correction passed 4/4 controlled cases, left 835 source hashes unchanged, and closed the owned process group; native Settings recovery passed an isolated macOS malformed-config scenario. Neither result validates full Implement, whole-app completion, or deployment. [Task 1]

Scope: console.
